snippet.title: Audio Trip: Dance Full Out Update | Meta Quest + Rift
snippet.description:
💃 Audio Trip: Dance Full Out update is OUT NOW on the Meta Quest store for $24.99.

Welcome to your VR Dance Dojo! The Full Out update features a brand new campaign mode, gameplay modifiers, achievements, and NEW SONGS. Catch gems, ride ribbons, dodge barriers, and smash drums on YOUR Audio Trip!

Featuring tracks from your favorite artists: Lady Gaga, Skrillex, Zedd, deadmau5, Tiësto, and more. The show begins December 14, 2022 on Meta Quest and Rift Platforms.
